title: R. al-Arbaʿīniyya ('On the Number Forty')

date.basis: MK: 'completed before' the date of the Majlis 10196 copy (ff. 120b-21a); the date is a copying date and only a terminus ad quem for composition; not asterisked.

addressee: Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī, for his son Nūr al-Dīn
occasion: Written at Akhlāṭī's instance; the author thanks God for being led to Akhlāṭī's circle (Akhlāṭī is also the main oral source of the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ).
manuscript: 3 copies listed: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 120b-21a (13 Jumādā II 828/2 May 1425); Qazvin MS 312/10 (1272/1856); Sipahsālār MS 2930 ff. 115b-118a (undated).
summary: A brief commentary on the hadith man ḥafiẓa arbaʿīna ḥadīthan, written for the son of Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī.
